concerns.text: Phase 6 (T033-T035) implements 'Failure Mode Explorer' and 'Embarrassing the Theory' deliverables. While the Analyze report flagged this as scope creep, from a coverage lens, these tasks have NO matching FR/SC in spec.md. The spec defines FR-001 through FR-009 and SC-001 through SC-005, none of which mandate a 'Failure Mode Explorer' script or a specific 'Embarrassing the Theory' report section. These tasks are orphaned from the specification requirements.

T019 requires storing 'full RAW synthetic data trajectories (all raw data points per iteration)' in `data/synthetic/trajectories/{seed}.npy`. The spec (FR-001, SC-004) and plan mandate a full sweep (1000 iterations x 6 rho x 4 n x 4 p) with p up to 5000. Storing raw trajectories for this volume exceeds the 7GB RAM and 6-hour runtime constraints defined in SC-004 and the plan. There is no spec requirement to store raw trajectories; the spec only requires generating data (FR-001) and collecting p-values (FR-003). This task implements a data storage strategy that contradicts the feasibility constraints of the spec, leaving the spec's feasibility requirement (SC-004) unaddressed by a valid task.

T010 implements a memory monitor that 'logs a warning if RSS > 6GB but does NOT raise an error'. Spec FR-009 mandates that the system MUST 'detect when... covariance matrix is near-singular... and apply regularization... or raise a specific error code'. While T010 addresses memory, it explicitly opts out of raising an error for a condition (high memory/instability) that FR-009 implies must be handled via error or regularization. There is no task that explicitly implements the 'raise specific error code' path for the high-dimensional instability condition defined in FR-009, leaving that requirement partially unimplemented.

T028 implements a 'permutation test generator' but lacks the explicit constraint 'respecting the correlation structure' found in spec FR-004. While the task description mentions 'Gold Standard', it does not explicitly mandate the correlation-respecting mechanism required by the spec. This is a writing gap in the task description that could lead to an implementation violating FR-004.

T032 stores bootstrap confidence intervals but does not explicitly require storing the permutation reference p-values or raw KS comparison data. Spec SC-001 and FR-004 require the KS statistic to be measured 'against the permutation-based reference distribution'. Without storing the reference data, the measurement cannot be independently verified, creating a gap in the traceability of the SC-001 requirement.
